jobs.description: Weitere Berufsbezeichnung:CPO; Chief-Product-Officer; Product OwnerStellenbeschreibung:About HeyGermanyGermany urgently needs international talent. Yet complex and lengthy recognition processes prevent many qualified professionals from working in the jobs they trained for. At the same time, employers struggle to fill critical positions.HeyGermany wants to change that. We are building the digital infrastructure to make professional recognition and work integration faster and easier. We are starting with nursing and plan to expand into other regulated professions. Our mission is to remove bureaucratic barriers and help international talent access jobs that match their qualifications.The RoleWe are looking for a hands-on, product-driven Founding CTPO with the ambition to build HeyGermany as a co-founder. You will take full ownership of both product and technology, from understanding customer problems and defining our product vision to building, launching and scaling the solutions.You will work closely with the Founder & CEO to shape company strategy, identify growth opportunities and turn our vision into a product that users love and businesses are willing to pay for.We already have a live MVP (www.hey-germany.com (http://www.hey-germany.com) ), an initial recognition engine and talent pool, 400+ talent pool conversions, our first enterprise pilot and secured public funding.Your challenge is to turn this foundation into a scalable, user-centric platform that can take HeyGermany from one profession to many, while building the product and technology capabilities to support long-term growth.What You’ll Do- Own our product vision, strategy and roadmap, translating customer needs, business goals and market insights into clear priorities and measurable outcomes.- Lead product discovery and development end-to-end, from user research, problem validation and prototyping to technical implementation, launch and iteration.- Own our technology strategy and architecture, building scalable systems for qualification recognition, document processing, workflow automation and talent matching.- Turn complex regulatory and bureaucratic processes into simple, intuitive digital experiences, with a strong focus on usability, customer value and conversion.- Stay hands-on in building the product, making key technical decisions across frontend, backend, APIs, data and cloud infrastructure while maintaining a high standard of product quality.- Identify and develop AI-powered product opportunities where they create real value, particularly in document analysis, structured data extraction, intelligent matching and workflow automation.- Work directly with international professionals, employers and domain experts to understand their needs, validate assumptions and continuously improve the product.- Define and track key product metrics, using data, user feedback and experimentation to drive product decisions, engagement, conversion and business outcomes.- Build and lead our future product and engineering team, establishing a strong culture of ownership, customer focus, speed and continuous learning.What We’re Looking For- We care less about your current title than about what you have built, your product judgment and the level of ownership you are ready to take.- 7+ years of experience in software engineering, product development or technical product leadership, with strong hands-on technical capabilities.- A degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience.- A proven track record of building and shipping digital products end-to-end, ideally in a founder, founding engineer, product-minded CTO, technical product lead or similar role.- Strong product thinking, with the ability to identify real customer problems, validate solutions, prioritize effectively and balance user needs with business impact and technical feasibility.- Strong experience with a modern web stack, ideally TypeScript, React/Next.js, backend development, APIs, databases and cloud infrastructure.- Practical experience building with LLMs and modern AI systems, including RAG, agents and evaluations, and using AI effectively in product development and day-to-day work.- Experience with product discovery, user research, UX principles, product analytics and iterative development. You know how to move from an initial hypothesis to a product that delivers measurable value.- The ability to make pragmatic decisions across product and technology, balancing speed, user experience, quality and scalability in an early-stage environment.- A strong understanding of how product decisions connect to business outcomes, including acquisition, activation, retention and monetization.- A founder mindset and strong connection to our mission**.** You want real ownership, are comfortable with the ambiguity of a pre-seed company and care about building a successful business, not just great technology.- Strong English communication skills are required. German is a plus.- Experience with document intelligence/OCR, B2B SaaS, marketplaces, HR Tech, Global Mobility or regulated/GDPR-sensitive products is valuable, but not required.What We Offer- €50,000–€65,000 annual base salary, with salary growth as the company scales, plus meaningful equity reflecting the founder-level ownership of the role.- The opportunity to become a true co-founder, with long-term ownership of product and technology and meaningful participation in the company’s upside.- Founder-level influence over product vision, technology and company strategy, with the freedom to shape what we build, how we build it and how we grow.- The opportunity to build our product, technology architecture and future product and engineering organisation from the ground up.- A live product, early traction, our first enterprise pilot and secured public funding. We are currently in conversations with investors for our next stage of growth.- The opportunity to work on a problem with tangible social and economic impact: helping international professionals access jobs that match their qualifications while helping employers access talent they urgently need.We believe professional opportunities should be determined by people’s skills, not by their ability to navigate bureaucracy.If you want to build both the product and the technology behind a company from the ground up, take real ownership and help shape HeyGermany as a co-founder, we would love to hear from you.Send us one product you've built that you're proud of, tell us what role you played in bringing it to life, and why this mission matters to you.katharina@hey-germany.com (https://mailto:katharina@hey-germany.com)Homeoffice:Umfang: Nach Vereinbarung

jobs.description: Join our diverse teams of passionate people and a career that allows you to develop both personally and professionally. At Getinge we exist to make life-saving technology accessible for more people. To make a true difference for our customers-and to save more lives, we need team players, forward thinkers, and game changers.Are you looking for an inspiring career? You just found it.Be part of Getinge as aQuality Management Engineer (m/f/d) QMS and ComplianceWe are currently looking for an experienced Quality Management Engineer (m/f/d) QMS and Compliance to join our Quality department in Aschheim-Dornach, Germany, or Solna, Sweden, part of the Critical Care product area at Getinge. jobs.description: At Bayer we’re visionaries, driven to solve the world’s toughest challenges and striving for a world where ,Health for all, Hunger for none’ is no longer a dream, but a real possibility. We’re doing it with energy, curiosity and sheer dedication, always learning from unique perspectives of those around us, expanding our thinking, growing our capabilities and redefining ‘impossible’. There are so many reasons to join us. If you’re hungry to build a varied and meaningful career in a community of brilliant and diverse minds to make a real difference, there’s only one choice.Senior Principal Scientist (all genders) - External API Development for New Chemical EntitiesYou are an experienced synthetic and process chemist with the ambition to shape the chemical foundation of our R&D pipeline for new chemical entities (NCEs) by designing, developing, and enabling synthetic routes that evolve into robust API manufacturing processes in partnership with our external CDMO network.In this Drug Substance (DS) Lead position within global CMC teams, you define and drive the DS strategy and are accountable for the DS contribution to the overall CMC package. Serving as the central interface between internal stakeholders and external partners, you lead chemical process development and API supply activities, enabling phase-appropriate, scalable, and sustainable manufacturing processes that ensure timely API delivery, robust product quality, and cost efficiency.YOUR TASKS AND RESPONSIBILITIES- Provide scientific leadership for the design, assessment, and optimization of synthetic routes for new APIs in preclinical and clinical phases, with a focus on speed, quality, cost, sustainability, and process understanding- Represent Drug Substance (DS) in global CMC development project teams and contribute to key scientific, strategic, and portfolio decisions, while ensuring a coherent two-way flow of strategy, decisions, risks, and progress between the internal global CMC team and external CDMO activities- Guide and challenge route design and synthetic methodology choices at external CDMOs, translating SAR-driven chemistry into scalable routes for preclinical and clinical supply and future production in alignment with the internal DS development strategy- Oversee external API campaigns for toxicology studies and clinical trials, including planning, risk assessment, supply-demand alignment, and budget oversight- Steer process transfers between external partners and into internal development or external manufacturing, ensuring knowledge continuity and phase-appropriate documentation- Contribute to robust, phase-appropriate control strategies. Co-author and review the Drug Substance sections of regulatory filings (IND/IMPD and briefing documents) and support responses to health authority questions- Provide CMC DS assessments for in-licensing opportunities- Provide chemical expertise and pragmatic troubleshooting across the internal and external manufacturing network. Actively contribute to the chemistry community by sharing knowledge and driving innovation across organizational boundariesWHO YOU ARE- Ph.D. in Chemistry or a related science, with extensive experience in the pharmaceutical industry, including an understanding of GLP/GMP and regulatory expectations- Strong background in synthetic chemistry, with an excellent understanding of reagents, methodologies, and reaction mechanisms, plus a solid grasp of analytical techniques- Experience in the CMC development of peptides is a plus- Experience in steering external partners (CROs/CDMOs) or working across an external manufacturing network is a clear advantage- Proven ability to represent chemistry and Drug Substance in interdisciplinary CMC or project teams and to act as an accountable interface between the internal organization and external partners- A strategic thinker with the ability to think innovatively, develop and analyze multiple solutions to complex chemistry problems, and challenge the status quo- Strong communication and project management skills across scientific disciplines, cultures, and organizational boundaries, combined with assertiveness, service orientation, and enjoyment of cross-functional teamwork- Fluency in English (negotiation level), both written and spoken; German is an asset and willingness to learn German is requiredWHAT WE OFFEROur benefits package is flexible, appreciative, and tailored to your lifestyle, because: What matters to you, matters to us!- We ensure your financial stability with a competitive salary between 109.800€ and 138.500€ per year (full-time) plus a variable component and a global equity-based cash plan. Your compensation is based on your qualifications, skills, and professional experience.- Your family is a top priority. We offer loving company daycare centers at multiple locations, support in finding childcare, time off for the care of elderly or dependent family members, summer camps for children, and much more.- We support your professional growth by providing access to learning and development opportunities, training programs through the Bayer Learning Academy, development dialogues, as well as coaching and mentoring programs.- We promote health awareness and opportunities for selfcare through various measures, such as free health checks with the company doctor.- We emb  diversity by providing an inclusive work environment in which you are welcomed, supported, and encouraged to bring your whole self to work.Be You. jobs.occupation: Head of PMO / Chief of Projects (m/f/d) (Leiter/in - Projekt-/Programmmanagement)
jobs.description: AURELIUS is a global alternative investor, distinguished and widely recognised for its operational approach. It focuses on private markets, in particular Private Equity and Private Debt. Its key investment platforms include AURELIUS Opportunities V, AURELIUS European Opportunities IV, AUR Portfolio III and AURELIUS Growth (Wachstumskapital). AURELIUS has been growing significantly in recent years, especially expanding its global footprint, and today employs more than 400 professionals in 10 offices spanning Europe, North America and Asia.AURELIUS is driven by a spirit of entrepreneurship, with a collegiate, hands-on approach to complex projects. We are motivated, open, fun, and operate as a team of equals.Create impact with passion!For an AURELIUS’ portfolio company located in Bavaria we are looking for aHead of PMO / Chief of Projects (m/f/d)As a Head of PMO you will lead and professionalize the end-to-end Project Management / Delivery function across the EMEA utilities business, spanning residential and industrial energy tech, software, and analytics solutions. You will own delivery from project definition through mass production and customer rollout, integrating Sales, Product Management, R&D, NPI, Procurement, and Quality into one disciplined execution engine. Furthermore, you will transform a currently fragmented, product- and site-centric delivery model into a standardized, cross-BU project delivery organization with clear stage gates, transparent KPIs, and predictable outcomes. The Head of PMO will act as the single accountable owner like a “project CEO” for on-time, on-quality, and on-cost delivery of projects and new product introductions, and as the primary interface to major customers for delivery commitments. Your task is to drive execution discipline, cost control, and margin protection across the full project lifecycle. The role requires frequent travel.Responsibilities1. Project Delivery Leadership & Organizational Ownership- Lead and develop the EMEA Project Delivery organization across customer projects, NPI, and cross-BU solution programs- Define and implement the organizational setup, governance model, and PM career path, including near-/offshore delivery capacity- Build a balanced delivery organization combining hardware project management, software/solution delivery, and NPI program management- Ensure scalability, agility, and clear accountability across all delivery units and sites2. End-to-End Engineering Delivery- Own end-to-end delivery from project definition through development, industrialization, mass production ramp, and customer handover- Act as the single point of accountability for on-time, on-quality, on-cost execution of customer projects and NPIs- Drive execution discipline, cost control, and scalable delivery models across multi-site and multi-BU programs- Establish a common project lifecycle, stage-gate framework, and PMO standards applied consistently across electricity, gas, thermal, software, and analytics- Ensure robust project planning, risk management, change control, and claim management on all major programs- Chair stage-gate reviews and enforce go/no-go decisions against scope, schedule, cost, quality, and business case3. Cross-BU Solution Delivery (HW + SW + Analytics)- Lead delivery of integrated solutions combining residential and industrial meters, head-end software, and analytics offerings- Break down BU silos and orchestrate cross-BU program teams around customer outcomes, not product lines- Establish shared solution architectures and reusable delivery playbooks across product families- Ensure consistent solution scoping, pricing input, and delivery commitments across the portfolio4. NPI & Industrialization- Collaborate with Operations on NPI program management from early involvement design, to design freeze through pilot, ramp, and stable serial production- Ensure early and structured involvement of NPI, Procurement, Manufacturing, and Quality in R&D projects- Drive design-for-manufacturing, design-for-cost, and design-for-serviceability discipline into every new program- Manage ramp readiness: supply readiness, test coverage, production line qualification, and yield curves5. Cross-functional Collaboration- Act as the delivery counterpart to Product Management (portfolio & roadmap) and R&D (technology execution)- Partner with Sales and Customer Projects to translate customer commitments into feasible, margin-protected delivery plans- Provide delivery input into bids, contract negotiation, and commercial terms (milestones, LDs, acceptance criteria)- Collaborate with Procurement and SCM to secure supply, lead times, and cost targets for project ramp- Collaborate with Quality to embed quality gates and field-performance feedback into delivery governance- Align with Finance on project controlling, revenue recognition, milestone billing, and cash collection6. Financial & Resource Management- Own the project delivery cost base and the aggregated margin performance of the project portfolio- Drive project margin protection: budget adherence, contingency management, scope and change control- Optimize allocation of PM and delivery resources across customer projects and NPI programs- Drive build vs. buy vs. outsource decisions for delivery capacity, balancing control, cost, and flexibility- Support business cases and mid-term planning with realistic delivery assumptions and risk-adjusted estimates7. Transformation & Change Leadership- Lead transformation initiatives to increase delivery productivity, reduce time-to-market, and improve predictability- Standardize and digitalize PMO tooling (planning, reporting, risk, resource management)- Build a high-performance, accountable, and customer-centric delivery culture- Drive upskilling and certification of the PM community across hardware, software, and solution delivery8. Governance, Risk & Compliance- Ensure project delivery complies with contractual, regulatory, cybersecurity, and quality requirements- Establish transparent portfolio reporting to the CEO and executive team, including early warning on at-risk programs- Own risk register for the delivery portfolio and drive systematic mitigationYour ProfileProfessional Experience- Minimum 15+ years of experience in project, program, and delivery leadership, including senior roles (VP/SVP level) in an international, matrix organization- Proven track record leading large-scale, cross-functional delivery organizations spanning hardware, software, and integrated solutions- Significant experience in customer project delivery in a B2B environment (preferably utilities, energy, industrial technology, or telecom infrastructure)- Strong NPI and industrialization background: bringing new hardware and software products from development into serial production and customer rollout- Demonstrated success in owning end-to-end delivery from project definition to mass production and customer acceptance- Experience running structured stage-gate and PMO frameworks at scale, with measurable improvements in OTD, margin, and predictability- Solid commercial acumen: contract, bid, and claim management; project P&L ownership; milestone billing and working capital control- Experience in driving organizational transformation and productivity improvements (cost, efficiency, time-to-market)- Experience in global/multi-site setups, including near-/offshore delivery structures- Exposure to carve-out, integration, or major transformation programs (strong plus)Intercultural Experience- Proven leadership experience in international and cross-cultural environments, managing teams across multiple geographies- Strong experience in navigating matrix organizations and global governance structures- High level of cultural awareness, adaptability, and communication effectiveness at executive and customer level- Fluency in German and English is a prerequisitePersonal attributes- University degree in Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field- Advanced degree (MBA or equivalent) is a plus; recognized PM certifications (PMP, IPMA, PgMP, SAFe) are a plus- Strong technical understanding across hardware, embedded systems, software, and cloud/analytics solutions — able to challenge and steer technical trade-offs- Deep mastery of project and program management methods, stage-gate governance, and modern delivery models (Agile at scale, hybrid HW/SW delivery)- Proven ability to drive execution at scale in multi-site, distributed delivery organizations, including vendor and outsourcing management- Data-driven delivery mindset: use of KPIs, portfolio dashboards, and analytics to improve OTD, quality, and productivity- Strong business and P&L awareness, with ability to protect and expand project margin under commercial pressure- Ability to connect customer commitments, technical execution, and financial outcomes- Strong ROI orientation: able to challenge scope, prioritize based on value, and terminate programs that no longer meet hurdle rates- Strong decision-making capability under ambiguity, especially in evolving organizational and carve-out setups- Excellent stakeholder management skills across CEO / board level, customers, suppliers, and internal functions- High degree of resilience and change leadership capability in transformation environments- Ability to attract, develop, and retain top program and delivery talentErgänzende Informationen:Anforderungen an den Bewerber: Erweiterte Kenntnisse: Aufsicht, Leitung, Projektmanagement

At the Max Planck Institute for Comparative Public Law and International Law, scholars pursue research relating to fundamental issues and current developments in the areas of public international law, European Union law, and the constitutional and administrative law of individual states, together with numerous visiting scholars from all over the world. In its fields, our library is the largest in Europe and one of the most comprehensive in the world.The newly established Max Planck Research Group “Constellations of Global (Dis)Ordering” (DISORDER), headed by Dr. Gordon Friedrichs at the Max Planck Institute for Comparative Public Law and International Law in Heidelberg, invites applications for twoResearch Fellow positions (Doctoral Researchers) (x/f/m)with a preferred starting date of 1 January 2027 (the positions are funded for three years)The Max Planck Research Group “Constellations of Global (Dis)Ordering” (DISORDER) investigates how global order is transformed as states - particularly great and middle powers - pursue competing visions of the principles, rules and institutions that structure international relations amid intensifying geopolitical rivalry. The group conceptualizes these processes as constellations of global (dis)ordering through which states seek to advance their visions of order by creating, reshaping, connecting, bypassing, or disengaging from international institutions, building new formal or ad hoc institutional arrangements, and strategically leveraging economic and technological interdependence. DISORDER examines how such constellations emerge across the fields of security, economy, and technology, and what forms of global order they produce, transform, or erode.Job descriptionThe successful candidates will develop independent doctoral dissertation projects within the framework of the Max Planck Research Group “Constellations of Global (Dis)Ordering” (DISORDER). Their research should contribute to the group’s broader inquiry into how states pursue competing visions of global order through international institutions and how these processes reshape global order across different issue areas.Possible orientations of the doctoral projects include:- an actor-centred perspective, examining how a particular great or middle power pursues its vision of global order across different issue areas institutional settings; or- a domain-centred perspective, comparing how different states interact with and reshape international institutions within a particular field, such as security, economy, or technology.Potential empirical cases may include, but are not limited to, the United States, China, Russia, India, Brazil, Japan, and other international actors such as the European Union.The doctoral researchers will:- develop and conduct an original PhD project that contributes to the conceptual and empirical agenda of the DISORDER research group;- conduct empirical research using qualitative methods such as process tracing, qualitative content and discourse analysis, and semi-structured interviews;- contribute to the comparative and collaborative research activities of the group;- participate in research group meetings, workshops, conferences, and other academic activities;- present research findings at international conferences and prepare publications for peer-reviewed academic outlets;- contribute to the organization of workshops, conferences, and other activities of the research group and the MPIL.Your profile- An excellent Master’s degree or equivalent in Political Science, with a specialization in International Relations or Foreign Policy Analysis- A strong research interest in global order, international institutions, and great- and middle-power politics, including their foreign policies- A substantive interest in one or more of the group’s empirical issue areas (security, economy, and technology)- A strong interest in qualitative research and familiarity with relevant research methods- Excellent written and spoken English- Additional language skills and country- or region-specific expertise relevant to the proposed doctoral project are considered assets- The ability to conduct independent research while contributing actively to a collaborative research environmentWe offer- An attractive and international work environment with an unparalleled research infrastructure and a good working atmosphere- A varied, responsible and team-orientated job- Remuneration in accordance with the guidelines of the MPG funding agreements (65 per cent of EG13, TVöD-Bund)- Access to our world-leading library and a multitude of databases- A workplace that is easy to reach by public transport and free employee parking spaces- A job ticket for public transport- Offers for work-life balance and four affiliated daycare centresApplicationThe Max Planck Society has set itself the goal of employing more severely disabled people. Applications from severely disabled persons are expressly encouraged. The Max Planck Society strives for gender equality and diversity. We welcome applications from all backgrounds. Furthermore, the Max Planck Society aims to increase the proportion of women in areas where they are underrepresented. Women are therefore strongly encouraged to apply.Interested candidates are invited to submit their complete application exclusively via the online application system (https://jobs.mpil.de/3vrp7) available on our website by 22 November 2026.Applications should include a CV, a cover letter of no more than two pages, copies of relevant degree certificates and transcripts of records, a one-page summary of the applicant’s Master’s thesis, a five-page PhD project proposal that clearly relates to the research agenda of the DISORDER group and indicates which of the thematic orientations outlined above the proposed project primarily addresses, and two letters of recommendationThe documents will be deleted after the application process. The interviews will take place in late November/early December in person at the Max Planck Institute for Comparative Public Law and International Law in Heidelberg. Application expenses cannot be covered.For questions regarding the positions, please contact Dr. Gordon Friedrichs at friedrichs@mpil.de (https://mailto:friedrichs@mpil.de) .

We’ll provide you with all the support you will need for your relocation and your start in Dresden.• Training & Development: Depending on your position, you will gain a deeper understanding of the processes involved in operating complex semiconductor equipment through unique hands-on training at the TSMC Newcomer Training Center, while continuously expanding your knowledge.• Health & Well-Being: An annual budget for your health and well-being (e.g., for sports classes, massages, or relaxation) helps you stay fit.• Meals & Transportation: Enjoy a daily meal allowance as well as a subsidized public transportation (e.g., for the Deutschlandticket) in Germany.About usEach journey starts with a first step.Joining ESMC at this early stage will provide you with the unique opportunity to actively shape the future of the fab in Dresden, boost your career and put your true potential to the test. You have ample opportunities to learn about TSMC Operations, Digital Transformation, and various advanced Facilities related topics, both in Taiwan and other sites around the world.Behind the world’s most advanced technology are real people with real passion. Our success is fueled by our core values: Integrity, Commitment, Innovation and Customer Trust (ICIC).We create a work environment that promotes diversity, ignites passion and enables you to reach your full potential.At ESMC, we welcome applications from all people, regardless of race, ethnic origin, gender, religion or belief, disability, age or sexual identity.

jobs.occupation: Instructor Hardware Technical Training (w/m/d) (Ingenieur/in - Systems Engineering)
jobs.description: Job RequirementsDo you want to help create the future of healthcare? Our name, Siemens Healthineers, was selected to honor our people who dedicate their energy and passion to this cause. It reflects their pioneering spirit combined with our long history of engineering in the ever-evolving healthcare industry.We offer you a flexible and dynamic environment with opportunities to go beyond your comfort zone in order to grow personally and professionally. Sounds interesting?Then come and join our global team as Instructor Hardware Technical Training (f/m/d) to train service professionals on advanced Varian hardware systems and help ensure excellent technical support for our customers worldwide.Choose the best place for your work - Within the scope of this position, it is possible, in consultation with your manager, to work mobile (within Germany) up to an average volume of 60% of the respective working hours.Even more flexibility? Mobile working from abroad is possible for up to 30 days a year under certain conditions and in selected countries.At the Kemnath location, you can look forward to attractive benefits, including subsidies for childcare and holiday care, an EGYM Wellpass corporate fitness membership, as well as many additional perks. You can find more information here.Please submit your application documents in the English language.Your tasks and responsibilities:* You conduct classroom and laboratory training sessions for groups of different sizes, from small expert groups to larger participant audiences* You perform intermediate equipment maintenance, including PMP/PMI activities, and demonstrate relevant service procedures during training* You troubleshot basic to advanced technical issues with limited support and guide learners through structured problem-solving approaches* You interpret schematic diagrams, technical documentation, software materials, and service information to create practical learning experience* You stay up to date on Varian product capabilities, system updates, and service requirements to ensure that all training reflects the latest standardsTo find out more about the specific business, have a look at https://www.siemens-healthineers.com/products-servicesYour qualifications and experience:* You hold a degree in IT, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Electronics Technology, or a comparable field with relevant working experience* You bring experience in field service or equivalent experience in engineering, technical training, manufacturing, or a comparable technical environment.* You are a certified Radiation Protection Officer and possess strong expertise in electronics* You have experience delivering technical instruction, ideally in a medical equipment or highly technical environment, and can explain complex topics to diverse audiences* You are confident using Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and email toolsYour attributes and skills:* You are fluent in written and spoken English and German and you have strong communication and presentation skills and enjoy enabling others to build technical confidence* You work independently, apply sound judgment, and make well-considered decisions when solving diverse and complex technical problems* You are result-oriented, structured, and able to manage classroom delivery, training logistics, and critical deadlines effectively* You meet the required qualifications to perform electrical operations and to serve as a radiation safety officer in accordance with German regulatory standards* You are willing to work alternate or second shifts, take on weekend assignments when needed, and travel domestically and internationally up to 50%Our global team:Siemens Healthineers is a leading global medical technology company. 74,000 dedicated colleagues in over 70 countries are driven to shape the future of healthcare. An estimated 5 million patients across the globe benefit every day from our innovative technologies and services in the areas of diagnostic and therapeutic imaging, laboratory diagnostics and molecular medicine, as well as digital health and enterprise services.Our culture:Our culture embraces different perspectives, open debate, and the will to challenge convention. Change is a constant aspect of our work. We aspire to lead the change in our industry rather than just react to it. That's why we invite you to take on new challenges, test your ideas, and celebrate success. Check our Careers Site at https://www.siemens-healthineers.com/de/careersAs an equal opportunity employer, we welcome applications from individuals with disabilities.#myabilityshsWish to find out more before applying? Contact us: recruitinggersupport.func@siemens-healthineers.com, if you wish to discuss any initial questions with our recruitment team. The contact person handling this job ad is Vanessa Türmer.We care about your data privacy and take compliance with GDPR as well as other data protection legislation seriously. For this reason, we ask you not to send us your CV or resume by email. We ask instead that you create a profile in our talent community where you can upload your CV. Setting up a profile lets us know you are interested in career opportunities with us and makes it easy for us to send you an alert when relevant positions become open.To all recruitment agencies:Siemens Healthineers' recruitment is internally managed, with external support permitted only when a qualified supplier has established a formal contract with us. Unsolicited candidate submissions and referrals, absent a current supplier contract, do not establish consent and are ineligible for fees. We delete and destroy unsolicited information, thus, would recommend you refrain from any such practices. Your adherence to our policies is appreciated.
